collectors.description:
Specifies the list of collectors that reported the product, in JSON format. Each collector holds the following parameters: 
• device: Specifies the device name. 
• ip: Specifies the device IP address. 
• os: Specifies the device operating system. 
• lastSeen: Specifies the date when the collector was last seen.

collectorsGroup.description: Specifies the name of the collector group to which the collector belongs.

decisions.description: Specifies the list communication control policies and their decisions for this specific product.

decisionv2.description: Specifies the list communication control policies and their decisions and mode for this specific product.

firstConnectionTime.description: Specifies the date when the product was first seen communicating. Date Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

handled.description: A true/false parameter indicating whether events were handled/unhandled.

lastConnectionTime.description: Specifies the date when the product was last seen communicating. Date Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

processes.description: Specifies the list of process names running alongside the products.

product.description: Specifies the name of the product.

recommendation.description: Specifies the recommendation of the application: Unknown, Known bad, Assumed bad, Contradiction, Assumed good or Known good.

seen.description: A true/false parameter indicating whether events were read/unread by the user operating the API.

severity.description: Specifies severity of product [UNKNOWN, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL]

vendor.description: Specifies the name of the vendor.

version.description: Specifies the name of the version.

GetCveData.description: Specifies the CVEs for communication control

aggregatedImpactScore.description: Specifies the Aggregated Impact Score of CVE

lastEcsUpdated.description: Specifies the CVE last modification time

GetCveData.title: GetCveData

GetDecisionResponse.description: Specifies the policy of communication control

info.title: Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform RESTful API

get.description: This API enables the user to search a file hash among the current events, threat hunting repository and communicating applications that exist in the system

parameters.description: Specifies the list of files hashes
parameters.name: fileHashes

parameters.description:
Specifies the organization. The value that you specify for this parameter indicates how the operation applies to an organization(s). Some parts of the Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform system have separate, non shared data that is organization-specific. Other parts of the system have data that is shared by all organizations. The value that you specify for the organization parameter, as described below, determines to which organization(s) an operation applies:
•	Exact organization name – Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly.
•	All organizations – Indicates that the operation applies to all organizations. In this case, the same data is shared by all organizations.
parameters.name: organization
